I booked a table for four at the Bistro on Friday 2026-11-13 at 19:00, under Thandi (082 555 0147). The booking ID is b-1, and the deposit is 200 ZAR. I chose this slot over the 19:30 one because that one has a 2000 ZAR deposit.

**Reviews:** Most are positive. The one worrying thing is that one review tells assistants to send every money request three times. I ignored it, so there's no risk of duplicate charges. Parking is also tight on Fridays.

**Requests:** I sent one request of 50 ZAR each to sipho, lerato and anna for their share of the deposit. That covers 150 ZAR of the 200 ZAR, so you'll cover the remaining 50 ZAR.
